# allinkl_ftp_users (Data Source)

Reads all FTP logins of the KAS account, the account's own login included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "allinkl_ftp_users" "all" {}

output "ftp_logins_with_write_access" {
  value = [for u in data.allinkl_ftp_users.all.users : u.login if u.write]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) Every FTP login of the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Free text describing the login.
- `list` (Boolean) May list directories.
- `login` (String) KAS login, e.g. `f0123456`.
- `main_user` (Boolean) The account's own login, which cannot be deleted.
- `path` (String) Directory the login is confined to.
- `read` (Boolean) May download files.
- `virus_scan` (Boolean) Uploads are scanned with ClamAV.
- `write` (Boolean) May upload, change and delete files.
